name: identity by checksum, joined has/has-not view
claim: Entries whose normalized content checksum is equal are one thing, so the has/has-not view joins a file path label and a git path label into one row that lists every label, with held and checked from whichever entry has them (docs/concepts/INVENTORY.md QI10).

models.result: A file built as a CRLF and an LF file path and read through repo_read as a CRLF git blob is 1 row with 3 labels, held and checked, not stale; a NUL-byte file with CRLF bytes does not join its LF twin; identical content in two files joins with both labels kept; a change parts the labels again and no record is rewritten. 13 new checks green (smoke 218 of 218, smoke-git 76 of 76). Limits: identical files join; a read label keeps its first checksum so it stays stale and apart after a change; short non-cryptographic hash.

name: inventory with captures
claim: Enumerating a target's blobs by label with metadata and extracted captures can be built by extraction alone (docs/concepts/INVENTORY.md I1).

models.result: No model takes part: 42 of 42 app/*.js files inventoried by the js-acorn capture provider, 0 failed, 1747 symbol entries, 228-776 ms in node and 766-907 ms in the page; verdict promote. The label question (file path against git path) is closed by QI10: both labels kept, joined by checksum.

means: The identity of a file's content: contentHash over its text with CRLF as LF (binary raw); equal checksums are one thing whatever the labels.
Derived from entries and check records: what is held and what was checked, per entry or joined per checksum with all labels.
